== Biography ==
Henry passed away 15 Feb 1874 at Killycurragh age 63. He was a farmer. Informed by Sarah Glasgow, Killycurragh.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/533d8c7514368 Henry Glasgow, 1874, Cookstown, 63] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>
<ref>PRONI Will Calendars: "The Will of Henry Glasgow late of Killycurragh County Tyrone Farmer deceased who died 15 February 1874 at same place was proved at Armagh by the oaths of David Harkness of Tintagh (Moneymore) County Londonderry and David Hamilton junior of Gortfad (Sandholes Dungannon) County Tyrone both Farmers the Executors."</ref>

He is buried at Derryloran Old Cemetery; his name is on the same headstone as his brother Benjamin.
<ref>{{FindAGrave|230936337}}</ref>
